description:
Cast Repository Skaab by paying its mana cost.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Repository Skaab exploits itself, its last ability and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. 
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a token copy of Repository Skaab that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Repository Skaab token instead.
